changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Creates the kabipay_ops schema that hosts operator plane and control plane tables.
changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS kabipay_ops;

rollback.sql: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS kabipay_ops CASCADE;

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Enables pgcrypto for gen_random_uuid(). Application layer still generates UUIDs; this is defense-in-depth for any raw SQL seed paths.
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Reusable trigger function: maintains updated_at on any row touched by an UPDATE. Every table with an updated_at column MUST attach a BEFORE UPDATE trigger calling this.
